bullets.text: In Pallikaranai, 300 people received work orders at a free employment camp organized by the BJP Tamil Nadu skill development and sports wing, and the office should monitor such local job drives.
In Tiruttani, a water tank built at a cost of Rs 16.75 lakhs has remained unused for three years, and the office should inspect it to resolve local drinking water problems.
In Avadi, devotees witnessed the sacred Kumbab অভিষেকm ceremony of Sri Kanakavalli Amman, and the office should track community events in the area.
In Ponneri and Puzhal, dense fog enveloped the regions, and the office should watch for any travel disruptions caused by the weather.
President Donald Trump threatened a heavy tax on US companies building AI data centres abroad, and the portfolio team should assess potential impacts on India's technology sector.
Karnataka proposed an AI-based facial recognition attendance system for students with online updates for parents, and the department should study this educational technology implementation.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated in Lucknow that AI cannot take away the jobs of skilled workers, and the ministry should align local digital upskilling policies accordingly.
